facts.fact: Google analysis published 5 October 2026 lists Hilo, Buffalo, Columbus, Punta Gorda and Greenville as rising domestic Thanksgiving destinations, measured by relative Google Flights search increase over 2025, not global absolute search volume.
facts.location: Publisher text; exact anchor begins the excerpt.
facts.excerpt: largest relative increase in Google Flights searches, compared to 2025. For Thanksgiving domestic travel, this year’s hotspots suggest a growing interest in tropical retreats

notes: Selection evidence only: US domestic Thanksgiving scope, not a worldwide November ranking or traffic forecast. Image ALT and main text read; AI summaries not used for facts.
